cases.task: Research how comments gate derives decisions across CLI and MCP, then plan any parity fixes a human should approve before implementation.

golden_questions.question: Which thread and suggestion states affect normal versus strict decisions?
golden_questions.expected: Normal mode fails only unresolved blocking threads; strict also fails unresolved non-blocking threads and pending suggestions.

golden_questions.question: Where do template and citation violations enter each surface?
golden_questions.expected: Path-aware validation is shared by CLI validate, CLI gate, MCP validate, and MCP gate.

golden_questions.question: What happens when a commented document has no template?
golden_questions.expected: Thread state is evaluated and structure is explicitly reported unchecked.

golden_questions.question: Do review records authorize the gate?
golden_questions.expected: No; the newest record is context only and current state derives the decision.

cases.task: Research how comment anchors survive document edits, including ambiguity and terminal failure, then plan a safe change to the cascade.

golden_questions.question: What is the ordered automatic re-anchor cascade?
golden_questions.expected: Exact position, exact text, normalized text, section fallback, then orphan.

golden_questions.question: How are ambiguous text anchors handled?
golden_questions.expected: Creation rejects ambiguous quoted anchors instead of guessing a line.

golden_questions.question: Who supplies explicit moves after an agent edit?
golden_questions.expected: The editing agent supplies comment ID to line or section moves; the automatic cascade is only a safety net.

golden_questions.question: How is failure preserved for later repair?
golden_questions.expected: The thread becomes orphaned with its original line, reason, and timestamp retained in the sidecar.

cases.task: Research the complete template contract agents must satisfy before plan review, then plan a compatible extension.

golden_questions.question: Which structural and prose-shape rules are deterministic?
golden_questions.expected: Required/order/word/subsection rules, question coverage, style, markers, and optional citation resolution are deterministic.

golden_questions.question: How are omitted research clauses detected?
golden_questions.expected: Research questions are numbered and findings claim them with Q tags; unknown and uncovered IDs are violations.

golden_questions.question: What does seed persist besides threads?
golden_questions.expected: It records the template name so later gate calls enforce the same contract.

golden_questions.question: Which decisions remain human-owned?
golden_questions.expected: Agents cannot resolve threads anchored in template sections marked zone human.
